scenes.heading: Amma: Reached?
scenes.narration: Have you reached home? For Meera, that message from her mother is part of every late night. Behind those simple words is someone waiting to know she is home.

scenes.heading: Meera’s walk home · Bengaluru · 10 PM
scenes.narration: It is ten at night in Bengaluru. Meera has just left Kuvempu Road metro station. Her room near Sri Vani Girls High School is about a kilometre away.

scenes.heading: Two extra minutes. A different walk.
scenes.narration: The shortest walk takes thirteen minutes. Another route adds just two minutes, but its score rises from sixty-seven to eighty-nine. With more mapped lighting and more places likely to be open, Meera can see what those extra minutes offer.

scenes.heading: See why · Evidence you can inspect
scenes.narration: Meera can inspect the lighting, transit and opening-hours evidence behind each score. SafeHer calculates the numbers, and Gemini explains the trade-offs. Each explanation is checked against the actual route data, rather than treated as a promise of safety.

scenes.heading: Plan B · Where help may be available
scenes.narration: If she needs to stop, Plan B estimates the walk to places where help may be available. The longest gap falls from over five minutes to just over two on the route with more support.

scenes.heading: 11:30 PM · The city around her changed
scenes.narration: At eleven thirty, shops have closed and both routes lose support. The shortest route now includes a long stretch with fewer support options. The street has not changed, but the city around it has. That is why her departure time matters.

scenes.heading: HerSide · Is the longer route worth two minutes?
scenes.narration: Meera asks HerSide whether the longer route is worth two extra minutes. With her trip attached, the assistant compares the actual routes and explains the difference.

scenes.heading: Nearby cafés · Grounded in Google Maps
scenes.narration: She can also ask which cafés stay open late. HerSide uses Google Maps information and provides sources she can check.

scenes.heading: Focused on her walk home
scenes.narration: When asked for a movie recommendation, it politely stays focused on walking safety.

scenes.heading: Someone walking with her · Simulated GPS
scenes.narration: Meera shares her location with her mother while the page stays open. She can stop sharing whenever she chooses. This demonstration uses simulated location updates.

scenes.heading: Urgent help never waits for AI
scenes.narration: Emergency call options are always available, without waiting for an AI response.

scenes.heading: Meera: Reached.
scenes.narration: Finally, Meera sends the reply her mother has been waiting for. I have reached home. SafeHer helps women in Delhi and Bengaluru understand their options, so the walk home is a better-informed choice, never a promise of safety.
